+  # On main (after a push, or by hand): a failure opens the issue "Main checks failing", or adds a
+  # comment to it if it's open, with the end of each failed step's log; a pass closes it. The logs
+  # come from main's own code. It checks out nothing and runs no npm.
+  main-report:
+    name: main report
+    needs: checks
+    # main only (not a run by hand on another branch), and only when the checks ran.
+    if: >-
+      ${{ !cancelled() && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
+      && needs.checks.result != 'skipped' }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      issues: write
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        shell: bash
+    steps:
+      - name: Download the logs
+        continue-on-error: true
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: ci-logs
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ci-logs
+
+      - name: Open, comment on or close the issue
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          STEPS_JSON: ${{ needs.checks.outputs.steps || '{}' }}
+          CHECKS_RESULT: ${{ needs.checks.result }}
+        run: |
+          title='Main checks failing'
+          repo="repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
+          run_url="$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
+          numbers=$(gh api --paginate "$repo/issues?state=open" \
+            --jq ".[] | select(.pull_request == null and .user.login == \"github-actions[bot]\" and .title == \"$title\") | .number")
+          issue=${numbers%%$'\n'*}
+          short=${GITHUB_SHA:0:7}
+          body="$RUNNER_TEMP/issue.md"
+
+          if [ "$CHECKS_RESULT" = success ]; then
+            if [ -n "$issue" ]; then
+              printf 'Main checks passed again on %s ([run](%s)), so the issue is closed.\n' "$short" "$run_url" > "$body"
+              gh api --method POST "$repo/issues/$issue/comments" -F body=@"$body" > /dev/null
+              gh api --method PATCH "$repo/issues/$issue" -f state=closed -f state_reason=completed > /dev/null

+            else
+              echo 'Main checks passed, and no issue is open.'
+            fi

+          fi
+
+          failed=$(jq -r '[to_entries[] | select(.value.outcome == "failure") | .key] | join(" ")' <<< "$STEPS_JSON")
+          printf '**Main checks failed on %s** ([run](%s)).\n' "$short" "$run_url" > "$body"
+          if [ -z "$failed" ]; then
+            printf '\nNo step failed, so the job timed out or lost its runner.\n' >> "$body"
+          fi
+          # The last 60 lines of each failed step's log, while the comment stays under GitHub's limit.
+          for id in $failed; do
+            log="$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-logs/$id.log"
+            [[ $id =~ ^[a-z0-9-]+$ && -f $log && ! -L $log ]] || continue
+            section=$(printf '\n<details><summary>%s</summary>\n\n```text\n%s\n```\n\n</details>\n' "$id" "$(tail -n 60 "$log" | sed 's/```/` ` `/g')")
+            if [ $(( $(wc -c < "$body") + ${#section} )) -lt 60000 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$section" >> "$body"; fi
+          done
+
+          if [ -n "$issue" ]; then
+            gh api --method POST "$repo/issues/$issue/comments" -F body=@"$body" > /dev/null
+            echo "Commented on issue #$issue."
+          else
+            printf '\n_Opened by the run above. Later failures add comments; a pass closes it._\n' >> "$body"

@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+name: Secrets
+
+# The secret scan on its own (#220): every pull request, drafts too, and every push to main, with
+# no path filter, so a pull request that changes only docs/, deploy/, the Dockerfile or a workflow
+# is scanned as well (ci.yml skips those paths). One short job, about a minute a run (0006).
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+
+# Grouped by pull request number. A newer push to a pull request cancels its older run; every
+# push to main is scanned, one after another.
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+# Decision 0011: it only reads the repository and runs none of its code.
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  scan:
+    name: secret scan
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      # The token isn't kept for later steps. The full history is for gitleaks.
+      - name: Check out
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      # A pull request's own commits; on main, the commits of the push, or the whole history when
+      # the push's first commit isn't known. The same pinned gitleaks (MIT) as ci.yml, checksum
+      # checked first; findings are redacted in the log. A false positive, such as a fictional
+      # password, gets a "gitleaks:allow" comment on its line, or its fingerprint (printed in the
+      # log) in .gitleaksignore. Changes to .gitleaksignore or a gitleaks config need a reviewer.
+      - name: Secret scan
+        env:
+          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
+          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          version=8.30.1
+          sum=551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb
+          dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks"
+          mkdir -p "$dir"
+          curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" \
+            "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v$version/gitleaks_${version}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
+          if ! echo "$sum  $dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --status; then
+            echo "The gitleaks $version download does not match its pinned checksum."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          tar -xzf "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" -C "$dir" gitleaks
+          from="$BEFORE_SHA"
+          if [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then from="$BASE_SHA"; fi
+          range="$HEAD_SHA"
+          if [ -n "$from" ] && git cat-file -e "$from^{commit}" 2> /dev/null; then
+            range="$from..$HEAD_SHA"
+          elif [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then
+            range="-1 $HEAD_SHA"
+          fi
+          "$dir/gitleaks" git --no-banner --redact --verbose --log-opts="$range" .

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+-- Workspaces, their roles and their members (Roles and permissions). Care Hub has one workspace for now.
+
+CREATE TABLE workspaces (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  -- The current workspace while Care Hub has only one.
+  is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT workspaces_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 65)
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspaces_default_key ON workspaces (is_default) WHERE is_default;
+
+CREATE TABLE roles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  -- admin, editor, commenter or viewer for the built-in roles (kept in step with the code); null for custom ones.
+  builtin_key text,
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  permissions text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_id_id_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_builtin_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, builtin_key),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_builtin_key_check CHECK (builtin_key IN ('admin', 'editor', 'commenter', 'viewer')),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
+  -- Admin settings belong to the built-in Admin role only.
+  CONSTRAINT roles_custom_not_admin CHECK (builtin_key IS NOT NULL OR NOT ('workspace.admin' = ANY (permissions)))
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_workspace_name_key ON roles (workspace_id, lower(name));
+
+CREATE TABLE workspace_members (
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
+  -- Members have exactly one role. Guests have none: they reach only what's shared with them.
+  role_id uuid,
+  joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  removed_at timestamptz,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, user_id),
+  -- The role belongs to the same workspace. A role that people have can't be deleted.
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_fkey FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, role_id) REFERENCES roles (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('member', 'guest')),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_check CHECK ((kind = 'member') = (role_id IS NOT NULL))
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_user_id_idx ON workspace_members (user_id);
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_role_id_idx ON workspace_members (role_id);

+-- Notices, part 2: the kinds other features send, foreign keys to `users`, and idempotency keys
+-- so a retried send adds nothing.
+
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices DROP CONSTRAINT notices_notices_kind_check;
+
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_kind_check CHECK (kind IN (
+  'reminder', 'alert', 'mention', 'comment', 'automation', 'reply', 'suggestion',
+  'suggestion_accepted', 'suggestion_rejected', 'edit_summary', 'shared', 'access_request',
+  'import', 'export', 'review'

+
+-- A person's notices go when their account does. A notice keeps its sender's name when the
+-- person behind it is deleted.
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices

+  ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_actor_user_id_fkey

+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

+/**
+ * Whether a database error (also when Drizzle wraps it) is a unique violation, optionally of one
+ * constraint or unique index.
+ */
+export function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown, constraint?: string): boolean {
+  let current = error;
+  for (let depth = 0; depth < 3 && typeof current === 'object' && current !== null; depth++) {
+    const { code, constraint: name, cause } = current as Record<string, unknown>;
+    if (code === '23505') return constraint === undefined || name === constraint;
+    current = cause;
+  }
+  return false;
+}

+name: Secrets
+
+# The secret scan on its own (#220): every pull request, drafts too, and every push to main, with
+# no path filter, so a pull request that changes only docs/, deploy/, the Dockerfile or a workflow
+# is scanned as well (ci.yml skips those paths). One short job, about a minute a run (0006).

+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+# Decision 0011: it only reads the repository and runs none of its code.
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  scan:
+    name: secret scan
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

+      # The token isn't kept for later steps. The full history is for gitleaks.

+      # the push's first commit isn't known. The same pinned gitleaks (MIT) as ci.yml, checksum
+      # checked first; findings are redacted in the log. A false positive, such as a fictional
+      # password, gets a "gitleaks:allow" comment on its line, or its fingerprint (printed in the
+      # log) in .gitleaksignore. Changes to .gitleaksignore or a gitleaks config need a reviewer.
+      - name: Secret scan
+        env:
+          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
+          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          version=8.30.1
+          sum=551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb
+          dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks"
+          mkdir -p "$dir"
+          curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" \
+            "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v$version/gitleaks_${version}_linux_x64.tar.gz"

+            echo "The gitleaks $version download does not match its pinned checksum."
+            exit 1
+          fi

+          from="$BEFORE_SHA"

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+-- Workspaces, their roles and their members (Roles and permissions). Care Hub has one workspace for now.
+
+CREATE TABLE workspaces (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  -- The current workspace while Care Hub has only one.
+  is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT workspaces_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 65)
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspaces_default_key ON workspaces (is_default) WHERE is_default;
+
+CREATE TABLE roles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  -- admin, editor, commenter or viewer for the built-in roles (kept in step with the code); null for custom ones.
+  builtin_key text,
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  permissions text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_id_id_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_builtin_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, builtin_key),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_builtin_key_check CHECK (builtin_key IN ('admin', 'editor', 'commenter', 'viewer')),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
+  -- Admin settings belong to the built-in Admin role only.
+  CONSTRAINT roles_custom_not_admin CHECK (builtin_key IS NOT NULL OR NOT ('workspace.admin' = ANY (permissions)))
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_workspace_name_key ON roles (workspace_id, lower(name));
+
+CREATE TABLE workspace_members (
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
+  -- Members have exactly one role. Guests have none: they reach only what's shared with them.
+  role_id uuid,
+  joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  removed_at timestamptz,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, user_id),
+  -- The role belongs to the same workspace. A role that people have can't be deleted.
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_fkey FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, role_id) REFERENCES roles (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('member', 'guest')),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_check CHECK ((kind = 'member') = (role_id IS NOT NULL))
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_user_id_idx ON workspace_members (user_id);
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_role_id_idx ON workspace_members (role_id);

+-- Notices, part 2: the kinds other features send, foreign keys to `users`, and idempotency keys
+-- so a retried send adds nothing.
+
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices DROP CONSTRAINT notices_notices_kind_check;
+
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_kind_check CHECK (kind IN (
+  'reminder', 'alert', 'mention', 'comment', 'automation', 'reply', 'suggestion',
+  'suggestion_accepted', 'suggestion_rejected', 'edit_summary', 'shared', 'access_request',
+  'import', 'export', 'review'
+));
+
+-- A person's notices go when their account does. A notice keeps its sender's name when the
+-- person behind it is deleted.
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices
+  ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_user_id_fkey
+    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_actor_user_id_fkey

+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

+/**
+ * Whether a database error (also when Drizzle wraps it) is a unique violation, optionally of one
+ * constraint or unique index.
+ */
+export function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown, constraint?: string): boolean {
+  let current = error;
+  for (let depth = 0; depth < 3 && typeof current === 'object' && current !== null; depth++) {
+    const { code, constraint: name, cause } = current as Record<string, unknown>;
+    if (code === '23505') return constraint === undefined || name === constraint;
+    current = cause;
+  }
+  return false;
+}

+  let closed = false;

index 0000000..5404c08
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/secrets.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+name: Secrets
+
+# The secret scan on its own (#220): every pull request, drafts too, and every push to main, with
+# no path filter, so a pull request that changes only docs/, deploy/, the Dockerfile or a workflow
+# is scanned as well (ci.yml skips those paths). One short job, about a minute a run (0006).
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+
+# Grouped by pull request number. A newer push to a pull request cancels its older run; every
+# push to main is scanned, one after another.
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+# Decision 0011: it only reads the repository and runs none of its code.
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  scan:
+    name: secret scan
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      # The token isn't kept for later steps. The full history is for gitleaks.
+      - name: Check out
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      # A pull request's own commits; on main, the commits of the push, or the whole history when
+      # the push's first commit isn't known. The same pinned gitleaks (MIT) as ci.yml, checksum
+      # checked first; findings are redacted in the log. A false positive, such as a fictional
+      # password, gets a "gitleaks:allow" comment on its line, or its fingerprint (printed in the
+      # log) in .gitleaksignore. Changes to .gitleaksignore or a gitleaks config need a reviewer.
+      - name: Secret scan
+        env:
+          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
+          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          version=8.30.1
+          sum=551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb
+          dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks"
+          mkdir -p "$dir"
+          curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" \
+            "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v$version/gitleaks_${version}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
+          if ! echo "$sum  $dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --status; then
+            echo "The gitleaks $version download does not match its pinned checksum."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          tar -xzf "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" -C "$dir" gitleaks
+          from="$BEFORE_SHA"
+          if [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then from="$BASE_SHA"; fi
+          range="$HEAD_SHA"
+          if [ -n "$from" ] && git cat-file -e "$from^{commit}" 2> /dev/null; then
+            range="$from..$HEAD_SHA"
+          elif [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then
+            range="-1 $HEAD_SHA"
+          fi
+          "$dir/gitleaks" git --no-banner --redact --verbose --log-opts="$range" .

+-- Workspaces, their roles and their members (Roles and permissions). Care Hub has one workspace for now.
+
+CREATE TABLE workspaces (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  -- The current workspace while Care Hub has only one.
+  is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT workspaces_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 65)
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspaces_default_key ON workspaces (is_default) WHERE is_default;
+
+CREATE TABLE roles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  -- admin, editor, commenter or viewer for the built-in roles (kept in step with the code); null for custom ones.
+  builtin_key text,
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  permissions text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_id_id_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_builtin_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, builtin_key),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_builtin_key_check CHECK (builtin_key IN ('admin', 'editor', 'commenter', 'viewer')),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
+  -- Admin settings belong to the built-in Admin role only.
+  CONSTRAINT roles_custom_not_admin CHECK (builtin_key IS NOT NULL OR NOT ('workspace.admin' = ANY (permissions)))
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_workspace_name_key ON roles (workspace_id, lower(name));
+
+CREATE TABLE workspace_members (
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
+  -- Members have exactly one role. Guests have none: they reach only what's shared with them.
+  role_id uuid,
+  joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  removed_at timestamptz,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, user_id),
+  -- The role belongs to the same workspace. A role that people have can't be deleted.
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_fkey FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, role_id) REFERENCES roles (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('member', 'guest')),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_check CHECK ((kind = 'member') = (role_id IS NOT NULL))
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_user_id_idx ON workspace_members (user_id);
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_role_id_idx ON workspace_members (role_id);

+/**
+ * Whether a database error (also when Drizzle wraps it) is a unique violation, optionally of one
+ * constraint or unique index.
+ */
+export function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown, constraint?: string): boolean {
+  let current = error;
+  for (let depth = 0; depth < 3 && typeof current === 'object' && current !== null; depth++) {
+    const { code, constraint: name, cause } = current as Record<string, unknown>;
+    if (code === '23505') return constraint === undefined || name === constraint;
+    current = cause;
+  }
+  return false;
+}

+  let closed = false;
+  return {
+    status,
+    headers,
+    body: (async function* () {

+    close: () => {

+    },

--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/secrets.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+name: Secrets
+
+# The secret scan on its own (#220): every pull request, drafts too, and every push to main, with
+# no path filter, so a pull request that changes only docs/, deploy/, the Dockerfile or a workflow
+# is scanned as well (ci.yml skips those paths). One short job, about a minute a run (0006).
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+
+# Grouped by pull request number. A newer push to a pull request cancels its older run; every
+# push to main is scanned, one after another.
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+# Decision 0011: it only reads the repository and runs none of its code.
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  scan:
+    name: secret scan
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      # The token isn't kept for later steps. The full history is for gitleaks.
+      - name: Check out
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      # A pull request's own commits; on main, the commits of the push, or the whole history when
+      # the push's first commit isn't known. The same pinned gitleaks (MIT) as ci.yml, checksum
+      # checked first; findings are redacted in the log. A false positive, such as a fictional
+      # password, gets a "gitleaks:allow" comment on its line, or its fingerprint (printed in the
+      # log) in .gitleaksignore. Changes to .gitleaksignore or a gitleaks config need a reviewer.
+      - name: Secret scan
+        env:
+          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
+          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          version=8.30.1
+          sum=551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb
+          dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks"
+          mkdir -p "$dir"
+          curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" \
+            "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v$version/gitleaks_${version}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
+          if ! echo "$sum  $dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --status; then
+            echo "The gitleaks $version download does not match its pinned checksum."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          tar -xzf "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" -C "$dir" gitleaks
+          from="$BEFORE_SHA"
+          if [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then from="$BASE_SHA"; fi
+          range="$HEAD_SHA"
+          if [ -n "$from" ] && git cat-file -e "$from^{commit}" 2> /dev/null; then
+            range="$from..$HEAD_SHA"
+          elif [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then
+            range="-1 $HEAD_SHA"
+          fi
+          "$dir/gitleaks" git --no-banner --redact --verbose --log-opts="$range" .

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+-- Workspaces, their roles and their members (Roles and permissions). Care Hub has one workspace for now.
+
+CREATE TABLE workspaces (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  -- The current workspace while Care Hub has only one.
+  is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT workspaces_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 65)
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspaces_default_key ON workspaces (is_default) WHERE is_default;
+
+CREATE TABLE roles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  -- admin, editor, commenter or viewer for the built-in roles (kept in step with the code); null for custom ones.
+  builtin_key text,
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  permissions text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_id_id_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_builtin_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, builtin_key),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_builtin_key_check CHECK (builtin_key IN ('admin', 'editor', 'commenter', 'viewer')),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
+  -- Admin settings belong to the built-in Admin role only.
+  CONSTRAINT roles_custom_not_admin CHECK (builtin_key IS NOT NULL OR NOT ('workspace.admin' = ANY (permissions)))
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_workspace_name_key ON roles (workspace_id, lower(name));
+
+CREATE TABLE workspace_members (
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
+  -- Members have exactly one role. Guests have none: they reach only what's shared with them.
+  role_id uuid,
+  joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  removed_at timestamptz,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, user_id),
+  -- The role belongs to the same workspace. A role that people have can't be deleted.

+/**
+ * Whether a database error (also when Drizzle wraps it) is a unique violation, optionally of one
+ * constraint or unique index.
+ */
+export function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown, constraint?: string): boolean {
+  let current = error;
+  for (let depth = 0; depth < 3 && typeof current === 'object' && current !== null; depth++) {
+    const { code, constraint: name, cause } = current as Record<string, unknown>;
+    if (code === '23505') return constraint === undefined || name === constraint;
+    current = cause;
+  }
+  return false;
+}

+  return async (hostname) => {
+    lookups.push(hostname);
+    const list = DNS[hostname];
+    if (!list)
+      throw Object.assign(new Error(`getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND ${hostname}`), { code: 'ENOTFOUND' });

+    headers,
+    body: (async function* () {

--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/secrets.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+name: Secrets
+
+# The secret scan on its own (#220): every pull request, drafts too, and every push to main, with
+# no path filter, so a pull request that changes only docs/, deploy/, the Dockerfile or a workflow
+# is scanned as well (ci.yml skips those paths). One short job, about a minute a run (0006).
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+
+# Grouped by pull request number. A newer push to a pull request cancels its older run; every
+# push to main is scanned, one after another.
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+# Decision 0011: it only reads the repository and runs none of its code.
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  scan:
+    name: secret scan
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      # The token isn't kept for later steps. The full history is for gitleaks.
+      - name: Check out
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      # A pull request's own commits; on main, the commits of the push, or the whole history when
+      # the push's first commit isn't known. The same pinned gitleaks (MIT) as ci.yml, checksum
+      # checked first; findings are redacted in the log. A false positive, such as a fictional
+      # password, gets a "gitleaks:allow" comment on its line, or its fingerprint (printed in the
+      # log) in .gitleaksignore. Changes to .gitleaksignore or a gitleaks config need a reviewer.
+      - name: Secret scan
+        env:
+          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
+          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          version=8.30.1
+          sum=551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb
+          dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks"
+          mkdir -p "$dir"
+          curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" \
+            "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v$version/gitleaks_${version}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
+          if ! echo "$sum  $dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --status; then
+            echo "The gitleaks $version download does not match its pinned checksum."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          tar -xzf "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" -C "$dir" gitleaks
+          from="$BEFORE_SHA"
+          if [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then from="$BASE_SHA"; fi
+          range="$HEAD_SHA"
+          if [ -n "$from" ] && git cat-file -e "$from^{commit}" 2> /dev/null; then
+            range="$from..$HEAD_SHA"
+          elif [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then
+            range="-1 $HEAD_SHA"
+          fi
+          "$dir/gitleaks" git --no-banner --redact --verbose --log-opts="$range" .

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+-- Workspaces, their roles and their members (Roles and permissions). Care Hub has one workspace for now.
+
+CREATE TABLE workspaces (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  -- The current workspace while Care Hub has only one.
+  is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT workspaces_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 65)
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspaces_default_key ON workspaces (is_default) WHERE is_default;
+
+CREATE TABLE roles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  -- admin, editor, commenter or viewer for the built-in roles (kept in step with the code); null for custom ones.
+  builtin_key text,
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  permissions text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_id_id_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_builtin_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, builtin_key),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_builtin_key_check CHECK (builtin_key IN ('admin', 'editor', 'commenter', 'viewer')),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
+  -- Admin settings belong to the built-in Admin role only.
+  CONSTRAINT roles_custom_not_admin CHECK (builtin_key IS NOT NULL OR NOT ('workspace.admin' = ANY (permissions)))
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_workspace_name_key ON roles (workspace_id, lower(name));
+
+CREATE TABLE workspace_members (
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
+  -- Members have exactly one role. Guests have none: they reach only what's shared with them.
+  role_id uuid,
+  joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  removed_at timestamptz,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, user_id),
+  -- The role belongs to the same workspace. A role that people have can't be deleted.
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_fkey FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, role_id) REFERENCES roles (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('member', 'guest')),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_check CHECK ((kind = 'member') = (role_id IS NOT NULL))
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_user_id_idx ON workspace_members (user_id);
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_role_id_idx ON workspace_members (role_id);

+  'import', 'export', 'review'

+-- Learning question banks (B9, docs/learning/api.md): questions kept once that quizzes in many courses draw
+-- from. Publishing a course copies the questions it draws into that version (banks/publish.ts), so changing or
+-- deleting a bank never changes a live course.

+-- table is on main.
+
+CREATE TABLE learning_banks (
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  id text NOT NULL CHECK (id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'),
+  -- A QuestionBank (packages/learning/src/banks/bank.ts), checked by the server before it is saved.
+  bank jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(bank) = 'object'),
+  -- Goes up by one with every save; a save names the revision it started from (decision 0304).
+  revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
+  created_by uuid NOT NULL,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, id)
+);

+ * Whether a database error (also when Drizzle wraps it) is a unique violation, optionally of one
+ * constraint or unique index.
+ */
+export function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown, constraint?: string): boolean {
+  let current = error;
+  for (let depth = 0; depth < 3 && typeof current === 'object' && current !== null; depth++) {
+    const { code, constraint: name, cause } = current as Record<string, unknown>;
+    if (code === '23505') return constraint === undefined || name === constraint;
+    current = cause;
+  }
+  return false;
+}

+  FetchLinkOptions,

+} from './fetch-link';
+
+const ICS = 'BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\nVERSION:2.0\r\nEND:VCALENDAR\r\n';
+const LINK = 'https://calendar.example.com/feeds/avery.ics?token=fictional-token';

+  'calendar.example.com': ['93.184.216.34'],
+  'mirror.example.org': ['2606:2800:220:1:248:1893:25c8:1946'],
+  'internal.example.net': ['10.0.0.5'],
+  'metadata.example.net': ['169.254.169.254'],
+  'mixed.example.net': ['93.184.216.34', '127.0.0.1'],
+  'nothing.example.net': [],
+};
+
+function resolver(lookups: string[] = []): Resolver {
+  return async (hostname) => {
+    lookups.push(hostname);
+    const list = DNS[hostname];
+    if (!list)
+      throw Object.assign(new Error(`getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND ${hostname}`), { code: 'ENOTFOUND' });
+    return list.map((address) => ({ address, family: address.includes(':') ? 6 : 4 }));
+  };
+}
+
+function reply(
+  status: number,
+  headers: IncomingHttpHeaders = {},
+  body: string | Uint8Array[] = '',
+): TransportResponse & { closed: () => boolean } {
+  const chunks = typeof body === 'string' ? [Buffer.from(body)] : body;
+  let closed = false;
+  return {
+    status,
+    headers,
+    body: (async function* () {
+      for (const chunk of chunks) yield chunk;
+    })(),
+    close: () => {
+      closed = true;
+    },
+    closed: () => closed,
+  };
+}

+  const requests: TransportRequest[] = [];

+    requests.push(request);
+    const respond = responses[Math.min(requests.length, responses.length) - 1];
+    if (!respond) throw new Error('No response');
+    return respond(request);
+  };
+  return { requests, transport };

+  } catch (error) {

+++ b/.github/workflows/secrets.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+name: Secrets
+
+# The secret scan on its own (#220): every pull request, drafts too, and every push to main, with
+# no path filter, so a pull request that changes only docs/, deploy/, the Dockerfile or a workflow
+# is scanned as well (ci.yml skips those paths). One short job, about a minute a run (0006).
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+
+# Grouped by pull request number. A newer push to a pull request cancels its older run; every
+# push to main is scanned, one after another.
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+# Decision 0011: it only reads the repository and runs none of its code.
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  scan:
+    name: secret scan
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      # The token isn't kept for later steps. The full history is for gitleaks.
+      - name: Check out
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      # A pull request's own commits; on main, the commits of the push, or the whole history when
+      # the push's first commit isn't known. The same pinned gitleaks (MIT) as ci.yml, checksum
+      # checked first; findings are redacted in the log. A false positive, such as a fictional
+      # password, gets a "gitleaks:allow" comment on its line, or its fingerprint (printed in the
+      # log) in .gitleaksignore. Changes to .gitleaksignore or a gitleaks config need a reviewer.
+      - name: Secret scan
+        env:
+          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
+          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          version=8.30.1
+          sum=551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb
+          dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks"
+          mkdir -p "$dir"
+          curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" \
+            "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v$version/gitleaks_${version}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
+          if ! echo "$sum  $dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --status; then
+            echo "The gitleaks $version download does not match its pinned checksum."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          tar -xzf "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" -C "$dir" gitleaks
+          from="$BEFORE_SHA"
+          if [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then from="$BASE_SHA"; fi
+          range="$HEAD_SHA"
+          if [ -n "$from" ] && git cat-file -e "$from^{commit}" 2> /dev/null; then
+            range="$from..$HEAD_SHA"
+          elif [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then
+            range="-1 $HEAD_SHA"
+          fi
+          "$dir/gitleaks" git --no-banner --redact --verbose --log-opts="$range" .

+++ b/apps/server/migrations/202610270035_workspaces_members-and-roles.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+-- Workspaces, their roles and their members (Roles and permissions). Care Hub has one workspace for now.
+
+CREATE TABLE workspaces (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  -- The current workspace while Care Hub has only one.
+  is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT workspaces_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 65)
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspaces_default_key ON workspaces (is_default) WHERE is_default;
+
+CREATE TABLE roles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  -- admin, editor, commenter or viewer for the built-in roles (kept in step with the code); null for custom ones.
+  builtin_key text,
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  permissions text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_id_id_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_builtin_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, builtin_key),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_builtin_key_check CHECK (builtin_key IN ('admin', 'editor', 'commenter', 'viewer')),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
+  -- Admin settings belong to the built-in Admin role only.
+  CONSTRAINT roles_custom_not_admin CHECK (builtin_key IS NOT NULL OR NOT ('workspace.admin' = ANY (permissions)))
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_workspace_name_key ON roles (workspace_id, lower(name));
+
+CREATE TABLE workspace_members (
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
+  -- Members have exactly one role. Guests have none: they reach only what's shared with them.
+  role_id uuid,
+  joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  removed_at timestamptz,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, user_id),
+  -- The role belongs to the same workspace. A role that people have can't be deleted.
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_fkey FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, role_id) REFERENCES roles (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('member', 'guest')),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_check CHECK ((kind = 'member') = (role_id IS NOT NULL))
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_user_id_idx ON workspace_members (user_id);
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_role_id_idx ON workspace_members (role_id);

+-- Notices, part 2: the kinds other features send, foreign keys to `users`, and idempotency keys
+-- so a retried send adds nothing.
+
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices DROP CONSTRAINT notices_notices_kind_check;
+
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_kind_check CHECK (kind IN (
+  'reminder', 'alert', 'mention', 'comment', 'automation', 'reply', 'suggestion',
+  'suggestion_accepted', 'suggestion_rejected', 'edit_summary', 'shared', 'access_request',
+  'import', 'export', 'review'
+));
+
+-- A person's notices go when their account does. A notice keeps its sender's name when the
+-- person behind it is deleted.
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices
+  ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_user_id_fkey
+    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_actor_user_id_fkey
+    FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
+
+-- For ON DELETE SET NULL when a person is deleted.
+CREATE INDEX notices_notices_actor_idx ON notices_notices (actor_user_id)
+  WHERE actor_user_id IS NOT NULL;
+
+-- One row per idempotency key a person's notices were sent with (SendNoticeInput.idempotencyKey).
+-- A key lasts as long as its notice.
+CREATE TABLE notices_idempotency_keys (
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  key text NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
+  notice_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES notices_notices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, workspace_id, key)
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX notices_idempotency_keys_notice_idx ON notices_idempotency_keys (notice_id);

+-- Learning question banks (B9, docs/learning/api.md): questions kept once that quizzes in many courses draw
+-- from. Publishing a course copies the questions it draws into that version (banks/publish.ts), so changing or
+-- deleting a bank never changes a live course.
+--
+-- workspace_id and created_by get their foreign keys in a later learning migration, once the `workspaces`
+-- table is on main.
+
+CREATE TABLE learning_banks (
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  id text NOT NULL CHECK (id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'),
+  -- A QuestionBank (packages/learning/src/banks/bank.ts), checked by the server before it is saved.
+  bank jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(bank) = 'object'),
+  -- Goes up by one with every save; a save names the revision it started from (decision 0304).
+  revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
+  created_by uuid NOT NULL,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, id)
+);

+export function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown, constraint?: string): boolean {
+  let current = error;
+  for (let depth = 0; depth < 3 && typeof current === 'object' && current !== null; depth++) {

+function resolver(lookups: string[] = []): Resolver {
+  return async (hostname) => {

+function reply(

+  headers: IncomingHttpHeaders = {},

+  const chunks = typeof body === 'string' ? [Buffer.from(body)] : body;
+  let closed = false;

+    })(),
+    close: () => {
+      closed = true;

+name: Secrets
+
+# The secret scan on its own (#220): every pull request, drafts too, and every push to main, with
+# no path filter, so a pull request that changes only docs/, deploy/, the Dockerfile or a workflow
+# is scanned as well (ci.yml skips those paths). One short job, about a minute a run (0006).
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+
+# Grouped by pull request number. A newer push to a pull request cancels its older run; every
+# push to main is scanned, one after another.
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+# Decision 0011: it only reads the repository and runs none of its code.
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  scan:
+    name: secret scan
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      # The token isn't kept for later steps. The full history is for gitleaks.
+      - name: Check out
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      # A pull request's own commits; on main, the commits of the push, or the whole history when
+      # the push's first commit isn't known. The same pinned gitleaks (MIT) as ci.yml, checksum
+      # checked first; findings are redacted in the log. A false positive, such as a fictional
+      # password, gets a "gitleaks:allow" comment on its line, or its fingerprint (printed in the
+      # log) in .gitleaksignore. Changes to .gitleaksignore or a gitleaks config need a reviewer.
+      - name: Secret scan
+        env:
+          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
+          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          version=8.30.1
+          sum=551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb
+          dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks"
+          mkdir -p "$dir"
+          curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" \
+            "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v$version/gitleaks_${version}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
+          if ! echo "$sum  $dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --status; then
+            echo "The gitleaks $version download does not match its pinned checksum."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          tar -xzf "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" -C "$dir" gitleaks
+          from="$BEFORE_SHA"
+          if [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then from="$BASE_SHA"; fi
+          range="$HEAD_SHA"
+          if [ -n "$from" ] && git cat-file -e "$from^{commit}" 2> /dev/null; then
+            range="$from..$HEAD_SHA"
+          elif [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then
+            range="-1 $HEAD_SHA"
+          fi
+          "$dir/gitleaks" git --no-banner --redact --verbose --log-opts="$range" .

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+-- Workspaces, their roles and their members (Roles and permissions). Care Hub has one workspace for now.
+
+CREATE TABLE workspaces (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  -- The current workspace while Care Hub has only one.
+  is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT workspaces_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 65)
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspaces_default_key ON workspaces (is_default) WHERE is_default;
+
+CREATE TABLE roles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  -- admin, editor, commenter or viewer for the built-in roles (kept in step with the code); null for custom ones.
+  builtin_key text,
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  permissions text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_id_id_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_builtin_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, builtin_key),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_builtin_key_check CHECK (builtin_key IN ('admin', 'editor', 'commenter', 'viewer')),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
+  -- Admin settings belong to the built-in Admin role only.
+  CONSTRAINT roles_custom_not_admin CHECK (builtin_key IS NOT NULL OR NOT ('workspace.admin' = ANY (permissions)))
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_workspace_name_key ON roles (workspace_id, lower(name));
+
+CREATE TABLE workspace_members (
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
+  -- Members have exactly one role. Guests have none: they reach only what's shared with them.
+  role_id uuid,
+  joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  removed_at timestamptz,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, user_id),
+  -- The role belongs to the same workspace. A role that people have can't be deleted.
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_fkey FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, role_id) REFERENCES roles (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('member', 'guest')),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_check CHECK ((kind = 'member') = (role_id IS NOT NULL))
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_user_id_idx ON workspace_members (user_id);
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_role_id_idx ON workspace_members (role_id);

+-- Notices, part 2: the kinds other features send, foreign keys to `users`, and idempotency keys
+-- so a retried send adds nothing.
+
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices DROP CONSTRAINT notices_notices_kind_check;
+
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_kind_check CHECK (kind IN (
+  'reminder', 'alert', 'mention', 'comment', 'automation', 'reply', 'suggestion',
+  'suggestion_accepted', 'suggestion_rejected', 'edit_summary', 'shared', 'access_request',
+  'import', 'export', 'review'
+));
+
+-- A person's notices go when their account does. A notice keeps its sender's name when the
+-- person behind it is deleted.
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices
+  ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_user_id_fkey
+    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_actor_user_id_fkey
+    FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

+  notice_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES notices_notices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, workspace_id, key)

+
+CREATE INDEX notices_idempotency_keys_notice_idx ON notices_idempotency_keys (notice_id);

+/**
+ * Whether a database error (also when Drizzle wraps it) is a unique violation, optionally of one
+ * constraint or unique index.
+ */
+export function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown, constraint?: string): boolean {
+  let current = error;
+  for (let depth = 0; depth < 3 && typeof current === 'object' && current !== null; depth++) {
+    const { code, constraint: name, cause } = current as Record<string, unknown>;
+    if (code === '23505') return constraint === undefined || name === constraint;
+    current = cause;
+  }
+  return false;
+}

+function resolver(lookups: string[] = []): Resolver {
+  return async (hostname) => {
+    lookups.push(hostname);
+    const list = DNS[hostname];
+    if (!list)
+      throw Object.assign(new Error(`getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND ${hostname}`), { code: 'ENOTFOUND' });
+    return list.map((address) => ({ address, family: address.includes(':') ? 6 : 4 }));

+function reply(
+  status: number,
+  headers: IncomingHttpHeaders = {},
+  body: string | Uint8Array[] = '',

+  const chunks = typeof body === 'string' ? [Buffer.from(body)] : body;
+  let closed = false;
+  return {
+    status,
+    headers,
+    body: (async function* () {
+      for (const chunk of chunks) yield chunk;
+    })(),
+    close: () => {
+      closed = true;
+    },

+name: Secrets
+
+# The secret scan on its own (#220): every pull request, drafts too, and every push to main, with
+# no path filter, so a pull request that changes only docs/, deploy/, the Dockerfile or a workflow
+# is scanned as well (ci.yml skips those paths). One short job, about a minute a run (0006).
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+
+# Grouped by pull request number. A newer push to a pull request cancels its older run; every
+# push to main is scanned, one after another.
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+# Decision 0011: it only reads the repository and runs none of its code.
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  scan:
+    name: secret scan
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      # The token isn't kept for later steps. The full history is for gitleaks.
+      - name: Check out
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5

+          persist-credentials: false

+      # A pull request's own commits; on main, the commits of the push, or the whole history when
+      # the push's first commit isn't known. The same pinned gitleaks (MIT) as ci.yml, checksum
+      # checked first; findings are redacted in the log. A false positive, such as a fictional
+      # password, gets a "gitleaks:allow" comment on its line, or its fingerprint (printed in the
+      # log) in .gitleaksignore. Changes to .gitleaksignore or a gitleaks config need a reviewer.
+      - name: Secret scan
+        env:
+          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
+          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          version=8.30.1
+          sum=551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb
+          dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks"
+          mkdir -p "$dir"

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+-- Workspaces, their roles and their members (Roles and permissions). Care Hub has one workspace for now.
+
+CREATE TABLE workspaces (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  -- The current workspace while Care Hub has only one.
+  is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT workspaces_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 65)
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspaces_default_key ON workspaces (is_default) WHERE is_default;
+
+CREATE TABLE roles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  -- admin, editor, commenter or viewer for the built-in roles (kept in step with the code); null for custom ones.
+  builtin_key text,
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  permissions text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_id_id_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_builtin_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, builtin_key),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_builtin_key_check CHECK (builtin_key IN ('admin', 'editor', 'commenter', 'viewer')),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
+  -- Admin settings belong to the built-in Admin role only.
+  CONSTRAINT roles_custom_not_admin CHECK (builtin_key IS NOT NULL OR NOT ('workspace.admin' = ANY (permissions)))
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_workspace_name_key ON roles (workspace_id, lower(name));
+
+CREATE TABLE workspace_members (
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
+  -- Members have exactly one role. Guests have none: they reach only what's shared with them.
+  role_id uuid,
+  joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  removed_at timestamptz,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, user_id),
+  -- The role belongs to the same workspace. A role that people have can't be deleted.
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_fkey FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, role_id) REFERENCES roles (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('member', 'guest')),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_check CHECK ((kind = 'member') = (role_id IS NOT NULL))
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_user_id_idx ON workspace_members (user_id);
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_role_id_idx ON workspace_members (role_id);

+-- Notices, part 2: the kinds other features send, foreign keys to `users`, and idempotency keys
+-- so a retried send adds nothing.
+
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices DROP CONSTRAINT notices_notices_kind_check;
+
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_kind_check CHECK (kind IN (
+  'reminder', 'alert', 'mention', 'comment', 'automation', 'reply', 'suggestion',
+  'suggestion_accepted', 'suggestion_rejected', 'edit_summary', 'shared', 'access_request',
+  'import', 'export', 'review'
+));
+
+-- A person's notices go when their account does. A notice keeps its sender's name when the
+-- person behind it is deleted.
+ALTER TABLE notices_notices
+  ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_user_id_fkey
+    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  ADD CONSTRAINT notices_notices_actor_user_id_fkey

+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

+/**
+ * Whether a database error (also when Drizzle wraps it) is a unique violation, optionally of one
+ * constraint or unique index.
+ */
+export function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown, constraint?: string): boolean {
+  let current = error;
+  for (let depth = 0; depth < 3 && typeof current === 'object' && current !== null; depth++) {
+    const { code, constraint: name, cause } = current as Record<string, unknown>;
+    if (code === '23505') return constraint === undefined || name === constraint;
+    current = cause;
+  }
+  return false;
+}

+  let closed = false;
+  return {

+    headers,
+    body: (async function* () {

+    },

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5404c08
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/secrets.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+name: Secrets
+
+# The secret scan on its own (#220): every pull request, drafts too, and every push to main, with
+# no path filter, so a pull request that changes only docs/, deploy/, the Dockerfile or a workflow
+# is scanned as well (ci.yml skips those paths). One short job, about a minute a run (0006).
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+
+# Grouped by pull request number. A newer push to a pull request cancels its older run; every
+# push to main is scanned, one after another.
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+# Decision 0011: it only reads the repository and runs none of its code.
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  scan:
+    name: secret scan
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      # The token isn't kept for later steps. The full history is for gitleaks.
+      - name: Check out
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      # A pull request's own commits; on main, the commits of the push, or the whole history when
+      # the push's first commit isn't known. The same pinned gitleaks (MIT) as ci.yml, checksum
+      # checked first; findings are redacted in the log. A false positive, such as a fictional
+      # password, gets a "gitleaks:allow" comment on its line, or its fingerprint (printed in the
+      # log) in .gitleaksignore. Changes to .gitleaksignore or a gitleaks config need a reviewer.
+      - name: Secret scan
+        env:
+          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
+          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          version=8.30.1
+          sum=551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb
+          dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks"
+          mkdir -p "$dir"
+          curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" \
+            "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v$version/gitleaks_${version}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
+          if ! echo "$sum  $dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --status; then
+            echo "The gitleaks $version download does not match its pinned checksum."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          tar -xzf "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" -C "$dir" gitleaks
+          from="$BEFORE_SHA"
+          if [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then from="$BASE_SHA"; fi
+          range="$HEAD_SHA"
+          if [ -n "$from" ] && git cat-file -e "$from^{commit}" 2> /dev/null; then
+            range="$from..$HEAD_SHA"
+          elif [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then
+            range="-1 $HEAD_SHA"
+          fi
+          "$dir/gitleaks" git --no-banner --redact --verbose --log-opts="$range" .

+-- Workspaces, their roles and their members (Roles and permissions). Care Hub has one workspace for now.
+
+CREATE TABLE workspaces (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  -- The current workspace while Care Hub has only one.
+  is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT workspaces_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 65)
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspaces_default_key ON workspaces (is_default) WHERE is_default;
+
+CREATE TABLE roles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  -- admin, editor, commenter or viewer for the built-in roles (kept in step with the code); null for custom ones.
+  builtin_key text,
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  permissions text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_id_id_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_builtin_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, builtin_key),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_builtin_key_check CHECK (builtin_key IN ('admin', 'editor', 'commenter', 'viewer')),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
+  -- Admin settings belong to the built-in Admin role only.
+  CONSTRAINT roles_custom_not_admin CHECK (builtin_key IS NOT NULL OR NOT ('workspace.admin' = ANY (permissions)))
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_workspace_name_key ON roles (workspace_id, lower(name));
+
+CREATE TABLE workspace_members (
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
+  -- Members have exactly one role. Guests have none: they reach only what's shared with them.
+  role_id uuid,
+  joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  removed_at timestamptz,
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, user_id),
+  -- The role belongs to the same workspace. A role that people have can't be deleted.
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_fkey FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, role_id) REFERENCES roles (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('member', 'guest')),
+  CONSTRAINT workspace_members_role_check CHECK ((kind = 'member') = (role_id IS NOT NULL))
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_user_id_idx ON workspace_members (user_id);
+CREATE INDEX workspace_members_role_id_idx ON workspace_members (role_id);

+/**
+ * Whether a database error (also when Drizzle wraps it) is a unique violation, optionally of one
+ * constraint or unique index.
+ */
+export function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown, constraint?: string): boolean {
+  let current = error;
+  for (let depth = 0; depth < 3 && typeof current === 'object' && current !== null; depth++) {
+    const { code, constraint: name, cause } = current as Record<string, unknown>;
+    if (code === '23505') return constraint === undefined || name === constraint;
+    current = cause;
+  }
+  return false;
+}

+    if (!list)

+function reply(
+  status: number,
+  headers: IncomingHttpHeaders = {},
+  body: string | Uint8Array[] = '',

+  const chunks = typeof body === 'string' ? [Buffer.from(body)] : body;
+  let closed = false;
+  return {
+    status,
+    headers,
+    body: (async function* () {
+      for (const chunk of chunks) yield chunk;
+    })(),
+    close: () => {
+      closed = true;
+    },

+  };

+  const requests: TransportRequest[] = [];

+    requests.push(request);

+      transport,

index 0000000..5404c08
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/secrets.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+name: Secrets
+
+# The secret scan on its own (#220): every pull request, drafts too, and every push to main, with
+# no path filter, so a pull request that changes only docs/, deploy/, the Dockerfile or a workflow
+# is scanned as well (ci.yml skips those paths). One short job, about a minute a run (0006).
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+
+# Grouped by pull request number. A newer push to a pull request cancels its older run; every
+# push to main is scanned, one after another.
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+# Decision 0011: it only reads the repository and runs none of its code.
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  scan:
+    name: secret scan
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      # The token isn't kept for later steps. The full history is for gitleaks.
+      - name: Check out
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      # A pull request's own commits; on main, the commits of the push, or the whole history when
+      # the push's first commit isn't known. The same pinned gitleaks (MIT) as ci.yml, checksum
+      # checked first; findings are redacted in the log. A false positive, such as a fictional
+      # password, gets a "gitleaks:allow" comment on its line, or its fingerprint (printed in the
+      # log) in .gitleaksignore. Changes to .gitleaksignore or a gitleaks config need a reviewer.
+      - name: Secret scan
+        env:
+          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
+          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          version=8.30.1
+          sum=551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb
+          dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks"
+          mkdir -p "$dir"
+          curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" \
+            "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v$version/gitleaks_${version}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
+          if ! echo "$sum  $dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --status; then
+            echo "The gitleaks $version download does not match its pinned checksum."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          tar -xzf "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" -C "$dir" gitleaks
+          from="$BEFORE_SHA"
+          if [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then from="$BASE_SHA"; fi
+          range="$HEAD_SHA"
+          if [ -n "$from" ] && git cat-file -e "$from^{commit}" 2> /dev/null; then
+            range="$from..$HEAD_SHA"
+          elif [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then
+            range="-1 $HEAD_SHA"
+          fi
+          "$dir/gitleaks" git --no-banner --redact --verbose --log-opts="$range" .

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+-- Workspaces, their roles and their members (Roles and permissions). Care Hub has one workspace for now.
+
+CREATE TABLE workspaces (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  -- The current workspace while Care Hub has only one.
+  is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT workspaces_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 65)
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspaces_default_key ON workspaces (is_default) WHERE is_default;
+
+CREATE TABLE roles (
+  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  workspace_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  -- admin, editor, commenter or viewer for the built-in roles (kept in step with the code); null for custom ones.
+  builtin_key text,
+  name text NOT NULL,
+  description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  permissions text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_id_id_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, id),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_workspace_builtin_key UNIQUE (workspace_id, builtin_key),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_builtin_key_check CHECK (builtin_key IN ('admin', 'editor', 'commenter', 'viewer')),
+  CONSTRAINT roles_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
+  -- Admin settings belong to the built-in Admin role only.
+  CONSTRAINT roles_custom_not_admin CHECK (builtin_key IS NOT NULL OR NOT ('workspace.admin' = ANY (permissions)))
+);

+/**
+ * Whether a database error (also when Drizzle wraps it) is a unique violation, optionally of one
+ * constraint or unique index.
+ */
+export function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown, constraint?: string): boolean {
+  let current = error;
+  for (let depth = 0; depth < 3 && typeof current === 'object' && current !== null; depth++) {
+    const { code, constraint: name, cause } = current as Record<string, unknown>;
+    if (code === '23505') return constraint === undefined || name === constraint;
+    current = cause;
+  }
+  return false;
+}

+const ICS = 'BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\nVERSION:2.0\r\nEND:VCALENDAR\r\n';
+const LINK = 'https://calendar.example.com/feeds/avery.ics?token=fictional-token';

+const DNS: Record<string, string[]> = {
+  'calendar.example.com': ['93.184.216.34'],
+  'mirror.example.org': ['2606:2800:220:1:248:1893:25c8:1946'],
+  'internal.example.net': ['10.0.0.5'],
+  'metadata.example.net': ['169.254.169.254'],
+  'mixed.example.net': ['93.184.216.34', '127.0.0.1'],
+  'nothing.example.net': [],
+};
+
+function resolver(lookups: string[] = []): Resolver {
+  return async (hostname) => {
+    lookups.push(hostname);
+    const list = DNS[hostname];
+    if (!list)
+      throw Object.assign(new Error(`getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND ${hostname}`), { code: 'ENOTFOUND' });
+    return list.map((address) => ({ address, family: address.includes(':') ? 6 : 4 }));
+  };
+}
+
+function reply(
+  status: number,
+  headers: IncomingHttpHeaders = {},
+  body: string | Uint8Array[] = '',
+): TransportResponse & { closed: () => boolean } {
+  const chunks = typeof body === 'string' ? [Buffer.from(body)] : body;
+  let closed = false;
+  return {
+    status,
+    headers,
+    body: (async function* () {
+      for (const chunk of chunks) yield chunk;
+    })(),
+    close: () => {
+      closed = true;
+    },
+    closed: () => closed,
+  };

+  const requests: TransportRequest[] = [];

+    requests.push(request);

+    if (!respond) throw new Error('No response');
+    return respond(request);
+  };

--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/secrets.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+name: Secrets
+
+# The secret scan on its own (#220): every pull request, drafts too, and every push to main, with
+# no path filter, so a pull request that changes only docs/, deploy/, the Dockerfile or a workflow
+# is scanned as well (ci.yml skips those paths). One short job, about a minute a run (0006).
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+
+# Grouped by pull request number. A newer push to a pull request cancels its older run; every
+# push to main is scanned, one after another.
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+# Decision 0011: it only reads the repository and runs none of its code.
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  scan:
+    name: secret scan
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      # The token isn't kept for later steps. The full history is for gitleaks.
+      - name: Check out
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      # A pull request's own commits; on main, the commits of the push, or the whole history when
+      # the push's first commit isn't known. The same pinned gitleaks (MIT) as ci.yml, checksum
+      # checked first; findings are redacted in the log. A false positive, such as a fictional
+      # password, gets a "gitleaks:allow" comment on its line, or its fingerprint (printed in the
+      # log) in .gitleaksignore. Changes to .gitleaksignore or a gitleaks config need a reviewer.
+      - name: Secret scan
+        env:
+          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
+          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          version=8.30.1
+          sum=551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb
+          dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks"
+          mkdir -p "$dir"
+          curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" \
+            "https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v$version/gitleaks_${version}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
+          if ! echo "$sum  $dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --status; then
+            echo "The gitleaks $version download does not match its pinned checksum."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          tar -xzf "$dir/gitleaks.tar.gz" -C "$dir" gitleaks
+          from="$BEFORE_SHA"
+          if [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then from="$BASE_SHA"; fi
+          range="$HEAD_SHA"
+          if [ -n "$from" ] && git cat-file -e "$from^{commit}" 2> /dev/null; then
+            range="$from..$HEAD_SHA"
+          elif [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then
+            range="-1 $HEAD_SHA"
+          fi
+          "$dir/gitleaks" git --no-banner --redact --verbose --log-opts="$range" .
